licensing.companyUse: Microsoft Sysinternals FAQ: no numeric limit for install/use on company-owned or supported devices, provided EULA followed
licensing.redistribution: Microsoft explicitly declines third-party redistribution licenses, including free bundle/share/web distribution; use internal link-only metadata; legal review required for copying packages into closed network

tools.name: TCPView
tools.use: List local TCP/UDP sockets, remote addresses and process owners. Tcpvcon -a -c -n can export local CSV without name resolution.
risks: GUI defaults to name resolution unless disabled
GUI Close Connection can terminate live MES sessions
Sensitive process, IP and hostname information
guardrails: Read only at first, use name-resolution off for diagnostic latency isolation
Do not close connections on production
Store CSV only in approved local evidence directory

tools.name: PsPing
tools.bundle: PsTools ZIP, includes PsExec/PsKill/PsShutdown and other privileged tools
tools.use: Explicit TCP connect/latency measurement for authorized MES interface endpoint. ICMP baseline only if approved.
risks: PsTools suite includes process execution/termination/service controls unrelated to PsPing
Active TCP probes generate network traffic
Some scenarios need server-side listener or elevated access
guardrails: Approval from operations/network owners for target, port, rate and duration
Never run -b or server (-s) on production by default
Import only the required PsPing tool, not whole PsTools operational suite, if allowed
Do not disable EDR, firewall or auditing

intakeSteps: Obtain company OSS/EULA/network owner approval for precisely named intended devices and transport method; resolve redistribution restriction with legal/publisher before any internal bundle/share.

On approved connected workstation, acquire original vendor archive directly from official Microsoft link and record timestamp, version, file byte count, SHA-256, Authenticode signers if present, and EDR scan result.
For restricted network, approve transfer method in writing; metadata-only Git catalog references official documents, never commits or republishes vendor EXE/ZIP.
At offline workstation verify local SHA again and observe first-use license prompt; keep product binaries outside public bundles and outside PortaKit auto-install catalog pending legal decision.

Perform non-production read-only socket inventory first. For PsPing require target/port/probe count and approved load budget; capture local-only stdout + same-text log and clean up without changing system settings.
